name: Manual Tracking of Mitotic Progression
description:
Perform manual tracking of a dividing cell in a 5D dataset.

1. Open the 'Mitosis' sample image (File > Open Samples > Mitosis (26MB, 5D stack)).
2. Create a Max Intensity Z-Projection (Image > Stacks > Z Project...) to create a 2D time-lapse.
3. Identify the dividing cell located near (X=145, Y=130) at Frame 1.
4. Manually record the X, Y centroid coordinates (in pixels) of this cell for Frames 1, 6, 11, 16, and 21.
   - For Frame 21 (after division), record the RIGHT-MOST daughter cell.
5. Save the coordinates to a CSV file at '~/ImageJ_Data/results/tracking_trace.csv'.
   - Format: Frame, X, Y
   - Example:
     1, 145, 130
     6, 146, 131
     ...
